messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] QTL mapping  with selective genotyping
parts:
While we discussed the treatment of selective genotyping for a binary trait in a recent paper (Manichaikul and Broman, Genetics 182:863-874, 2009), our code has not yet been incorporated into R/qtl.

However, if you have multiple affected and unaffected individuals with genotype data, you can detect QTL using the ordinary approach to mapping loci for binary traits, ignoring the selective genotyping: scanone() with model="binary".

If you have genotypes only on affected individuals, you're only option is to look for deviations from normal segregation at the genetic markers (1:2:1 in an intercross and 1:1 in a backcross), with geno.table().

karl
